subject: Simulcast routing plan + registration dedupe & recording clearance
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightstage.events>, platform@on24.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Simulcast routing plan + registration dedupe & recording clearance

Hi Elena / ON24 team,

Following up from last week's call — we're finalizing the simulcast plan for the Oct 14 webinar (Redwood x DataScale customer summit). Two asks before we lock the runbook: 

1) Routing & encoder allocation: BrightStage mentioned using a single encoder with two RTMP outputs (ON24 + Zoom Events). Can you confirm the expected peak bitrate and whether your encoder mapping worksheet below covers audio-only backup streams? I've attached an updated encoder_mapping_v2.xlsx with our suggested fallbacks.

2) Registration dedupe: we need a clear approach to avoid duplicate registrants between ON24 and Zoom (we run ON24 for the webcast hub and Zoom for breakout/QA). What's the recommended canonical source of truth for signup IDs and how do we reconcile cross-platform registrant IDs? Ideally we avoid double-emails and ensure the registrant can access recording assets without getting two invites.

3) Recording permissions & rights: Legal needs a one-line confirmation that ON24/Zoom will provide recording files with timestamps and a release allowing Redwood to host on our content hub. If there are any sponsor limitations around editing or excerpts, flag them now.

Please respond with short bullets (peak bitrate, encoder outputs, recommended dedupe key) — Marissa, Tessa: tagging you for ops/registration constraints.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: encoder_mapping_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightstage.events>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: platform@on24.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Simulcast routing plan + registration dedupe & recording clearance

Thanks Aditya — quick answers below from BrightStage side: 

- Peak bitrate: plan for 6.5 Mbps (video 5.5 Mbps + 1.0 Mbps audio). We'll cap at 7 Mbps to allow short bursts.
- Encoder outputs: our standard config supports dual RTMP with audio-only MP3 fallback to a third endpoint (for downstream archiving). The attached mapping looks fine; I recommended switching the secondary output order so Zoom gets the higher-bitrate stream (better for breakouts).
- Registrant dedupe: we typically use email as the canonical dedupe key with a hashed registrant_id synced to both platforms. We can provide a one-time CSV post-event mapping email -> ON24_id -> Zoom_id for your CDP.

Recording/rights: BrightStage has no sponsor restrictions. However, sponsors that provide pre-produced clips sometimes request a 72-hour embargo on edits. We'll surface any sponsor stipulations.

If ON24 can confirm the file formats and timestamp granularity, we can finalize.

Cheers,
Elena Morales
Senior Producer, BrightStage Events

Attachments: none
From: ON24 Platform <platform@on24.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, elena@brightstage.events
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Simulcast routing plan + registration dedupe & recording clearance

Hi all,

Quick confirmation from ON24: 

- Delivered recording files: ON24 provides an MP4 export per session with chapter timestamps at 1-second resolution. We also provide an m3u8 HLS archive for streaming delivery.
- Metadata: exported CSV has ON24_registrant_id, email, first_name, last_name, and timestamp of join/leave. We do not overwrite external platform IDs — that mapping needs to be supplied by the organizer (BrightStage can produce the mapping as Elena suggested).
- Format & retention: standard delivery within 24 hours post-event. We can extend retention/export SLA to 48 hours for an extra fee (let me know if Redwood needs this).

On dedupe: we recommend email+event_id hashed as the best cross-platform key since Zoom may issue separate event-specific IDs.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call to run through the post-event CSV structure.

Regards,
ON24 Platform Team
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, elena@brightstage.events, platform@on24.com
Cc: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Simulcast routing plan + registration dedupe & recording clearance

Thanks — helpful. A few operational notes from our side: 

- Registrant form fields: we need (1) company, (2) role, (3) country, (4) consent checkbox for recording reuse, and (5) sponsor opt-out checkbox. Tessa: can you confirm ON24's form supports conditional sponsor opt-out logic?
- Access emails: prefer a single consolidated access email from ON24 that includes both the live link and a backup Zoom link. We want to avoid two separate mailers to registrants.
- Recording release: Legal asked for a one-line clause in our confirmation: "By registering you consent to the event being recorded and to Redwood Inference's use of the recording for marketing purposes unless you opt out via the sponsor opt-out checkbox." Can we get confirmation this language is compatible with your recording export process?

Also attaching registrant-fields-proposal.pdf with the exact copy for opt-in/opt-out language. If all good, I'll ask Legal to sign off and we'll push to BrightStage to implement the dedupe CSV step in the runbook.

—Marissa
Director, Event Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: registrant-fields-proposal.pdf (PDF)
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, elena@brightstage.events, platform@on24.com
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Simulcast routing plan + registration dedupe & recording clearance

Looping back with the final confirmations after short sync with engineering and legal: 

- ON24 form fields: confirmed — ON24 supports conditional sponsor opt-out and custom consent copy. We can surface the opt-out in the confirmation email and exclude those registrants from post-event marketing exports.
- Consolidated access email: ON24 will send the primary access mail; BrightStage will trigger a secondary reminder 1 hour before (same mail, different subject). We'll configure ON24 to suppress the separate Zoom invite and instead include the Zoom access link inside the ON24 access mail as a secondary join link.
- Recording clause: ON24/legal reviewed the suggested sentence and confirmed compatibility. ON24 can add the consent flag in the post-event CSV as "consent_recording": true/false.
- Encoder allocation: BrightStage to flip the primary output to Zoom for higher-bitrate, as requested.

Next steps: BrightStage to produce the final dedupe mapping CSV within 48 hours after the event; ON24 to deliver MP4 + HLS within 24 hours. Legal to sign off on the registration copy by EOD Friday (I've copied legal in a separate thread).

Thanks everyone — this clears the major outstanding items.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Events Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
